policy.physicalCreation: Create the Oceania continent and region indexes first. Country parents and Australia child repositories remain planned until maintainers and datasets are ready.
policy.ownerRequirement: Create repositories only while authenticated as the target owner or an organization admin. Do not let GitHub CLI fall back to the current personal account.
policy.noRawAddress: Do not store raw personal addresses, recipient records, private coordinates, witness data, or private keys in public repositories.
policy.islandAndMarineBoundary: Oceania packs may store island, reef, atoll, port, shore-handoff, and coarse marine area references, but precise private coordinates and large GIS extracts stay outside GitHub.
policy.heavyData: Keep building polygons, coordinates, search indexes, tiles, OSM/Overture extracts, hydrographic data, and generated caches in external content-addressed packs.

repositories.creationRationale: The continent index can be completed with safe coordination metadata before any country dataset is published.
